title: Near a smooth prime the conormal module is free on some of the given generators
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,m\ge0$, $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $f_1,\dots,f_m\in P$, $I=(f_1,\dots,f_m)\subseteq P$ and $A=P/I$; the conormal module $I/I^2$ is an $A$-module. Let $\mathfrak q\subset A$ be a prime ideal such that $R\to A$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Then there are $a\in P$ whose image $\bar a\in A$ does not lie in $\mathfrak q$ and a subset $V\subseteq\{1,\dots,m\}$ with $c:=|V|\le\min(n,m)$ such that (i) the localization $A_{\bar a}$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]; (ii) the localization $(I/I^2)_{\bar a}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is a free $A_{\bar a}$-module with basis the classes of $f_j$, $j\in V$; (iii) the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A_{\bar a}/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a free $A_{\bar a}$-module of rank $n-c$.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement and proof against Stacks Smoothing Ring Maps Lemma 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard). Four steps: choose a smooth principal neighbourhood and use the split conormal sequence; select from the given relation classes a residue-field basis, whose size c is at most m and n and whose complementary differential fibre has dimension n-c; spread that prescribed basis by the new unsplit 0GWM helper lem-weil-pbc-prescribed-residue-basis-spreads and keep smoothness under further localization; spread the finite projective differential module with rank n-c using the existing 0GWM Mathlib leaf. The source additionally selects coordinate differentials and derives a Jacobian minor; this item asks only for freeness, so that later part is not used. No Lean files were changed or built.

lean.statement: theorem exists_smoothAtPrime_free_conormal_basis (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) (hs : Algebra.IsSmoothAtPrime R q) : ∃ (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R), Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a ∉ q.asIdeal ∧ ∃ (V : Finset (Fin m)) (c : ℕ), V.card = c ∧ c ≤ min n m ∧ Algebra.Smooth R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) ∧ (∃ (e : Fin c ≃ V), ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin c) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) (LocalizedModule.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent), ∀ j : Fin c, b j = LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).toCotangent ⟨f (e j).1, Ideal.subset_span ⟨(e j).1, rfl⟩⟩)) ∧ Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (n - c)) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) (KaehlerDifferential R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a))))
